prompt:
Create a looping animation of a humanoid character pushing an object forward using a broom. Start in a forward athletic stance with hips lowered, spine and chest leaned slightly toward the object, feet shoulder width apart. Both hands hold the broom: upper hand near chest, lower hand near waist. Keep the broom head on the ground directly behind the object.
Perform a controlled forward push: arms extend slightly as the broom drives the object away from the character. Keep elbows bent but firm, with minimal backward motion. After each push, make a short, small reset by sliding the broom back only enough to start the next push, without lifting the broom head from the ground. Shoulders and spine move subtly; avoid large torso pulls. Hips and legs stay stable, feet planted. Make the loop smooth, with a consistent forward-push rhythm and no visible reset.
